theme: Dark Afro-centric Luxury Gold & Warm Bronze

design_philosophy.core: Bronze Blitz combines rich Black culture iconography (Vinyl, Afro Pick, Kente Gem, Boombox, Golden Crown, Sneaker, Djembe Drum) with high-octane Match-3 casual arcade mechanics. Metallic accents, glowing Starlite neon effects, and tactile feedback deliver a top 1% mobile-first gaming experience.
rules: No generic emojis for game tiles — use vibrant Lucide SVG icons custom styled with radial gradients, outer glow, and distinct color themes
Rich dark obsidian background (#0A070D) paired with deep metallic bronze (#C87D32), Starlite gold (#FFD700), electric amethyst (#8A2BE2), and radiant emerald (#10B981)
Strict data-testid coverage across every game tile, HUD button, shop item, leaderboard tab, trophy badge, and modal control
Fluid animations powered by Framer Motion: springy tile swaps, tile match pops, cascading drops, screen shakes on special combos, and Starlite coin particle animations

typography.heading_h1: text-3xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-300 via-amber-400 to-orange-500

special_tiles.effect: Clears all tiles of matched color

key_components: GameGrid (8x8 interactive grid with Framer Motion drag/click swap)
LevelMap (Path of levels 1-30 with star ratings, current unlock status)
HUD (Live Score, Target, Moves/Time Left, Starlite balance, Pause)
ShopModal (Purchase powerups, unlock board cosmetic themes like 'Golden Kente', 'Harlem Nights', 'Neo Afro-Futurism')
TrophiesPage (Achievements list with claimable Starlite rewards)
LeaderboardModal (Mode-filtered top scores with local/cloud player rank)
PlayerProfileModal (Edit avatar, cloud sync player tag, stat summaries)
WinLoseModal (Star rating animation, score breakdown, Starlite gain, replay/next buttons)
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep all React component files concise, modular, and in .js format.
2. Ensure localStorage automatically saves player profile, Starlite currency, unlocked levels, shop themes, and achievements.
3. Provide sound toggle state (with Web Audio API synthetic beeps/chimes for matches and swaps).
4. Add visual particles or popups when Starlites are earned or combos exceed 4 tiles.
5. Ensure full responsiveness for mobile screens (portrait 360px+) and desktop displays.
